description:
Patient Oliver Twist (P00501) has called to cancel his scheduled 'Inguinal Hernia Repair' surgery because he has the flu.

1. Locate patient Oliver Twist in the patient list.
2. Navigate to his 'Operative Plans' section.
3. Open the planned 'Inguinal Hernia Repair' procedure.
4. Change the status to 'Canceled'.
5. Add a note in the admission instructions or notes field: 'Patient has severe flu. Surgery cancelled per Dr. Smith.'
6. Save the record.
